title: Reporting statements (1): that-clauses
summary: Придаточные с **that** после глаголов речи: когда that нужен, замена местоимений и слов-указателей (**tomorrow → the next day**).
ru:
## Основная схема
**Вводный глагол + (that) + придаточное**: *She said (that) she was tired.* В разговорной речи **that** после частых глаголов (**say, tell, think, know, hope, believe**) обычно опускают. Но в более формальных текстах и в ряде случаев опускать его нельзя или нежелательно.

## Когда that лучше сохранить
- **Официальный или письменный стиль**, глаголы **announce, state, declare, confirm, maintain, assert, reveal, point out, concede, stress, claim, indicate**: > The minister **announced that** the budget would be revised. — Министр объявил, что бюджет будет пересмотрен.
- **Между глаголом и придаточным стоит наречие или обстоятельство** (после одного лишь дополнения-лица that можно опустить: *He told me he was ill*): > She said **quietly that** she would not sign. > He told me **yesterday that** the deal had collapsed.
- **Несколько придаточных подряд** — повтор that помогает слушателю: > She said **that** she was exhausted **and that** she wanted to go home.
- **Придаточное начинается с обстоятельства или вводного оборота**: > He said **that**, in his opinion, the plan would fail.
- **that-clause как подлежащее**: *That she had lied surprised nobody.* (формально; чаще: *It surprised nobody that she had lied.*).

## Что меняется в придаточном
В косвенной речи меняются местоимения и слова-указатели, если мы говорим в другом месте или в другое время.

| В прямой речи | В косвенной |
|---|---|
| now, today | then, at that time; that day |
| yesterday | the day before, the previous day |
| tomorrow | the next day, the following day |
| last week / ago | the week before / before, earlier |
| this, these, here | that, those, there |

> "I'll see you **tomorrow**," Tom said. → Tom said he would see me **the next day**.
> "We moved **here** two years **ago**." → She said they had moved **there** two years **before**.
Если слова произнесены сегодня и мы сообщаем их в тот же день и в том же месте, указатели можно оставить: *She said she'd come **tomorrow**.*

## Глаголы с that-clause: нужно ли лицо?
- **tell, remind, assure, convince, warn, inform** — всегда с лицом: *He assured **us** that it was safe.*
- **say, explain, mention, announce, suggest, point out** — лицо вводится через **to**: *She explained **to us** that the system was down.* ~~She explained us that...~~

## That после существительных и прилагательных
Существительные: **news, claim, rumour, evidence, proof, belief, hope, fact, idea, suspicion** — that обязателен: > We were shocked by the **news that** the factory would close. > There is no **evidence that** he lied. > The **fact that** she lied hurt him.
Прилагательные: **afraid, sure, certain, aware, glad, sorry, surprised**; а также **It's a pity / a shame / strange that...** — that можно опустить в разговорной речи.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~She said me that she was tired.~~ → She **told me** that... / She **said** that...
- ~~He told that he was ill.~~ → He **told us** that he was ill.
- ~~I told to him that...~~ → I told **him** that...
- ~~He said that "I am tired".~~ → He said that **he was** tired. (нельзя смешивать прямую и косвенную речь)
- ~~She explained me that...~~ → She explained **to me** that...
en:
## The basic pattern
**Reporting verb + (that) + clause**: *She said (that) she was tired.* In conversation we usually drop **that** after common verbs (**say, tell, think, know, hope, believe**). In formal writing, and in several other cases, it should be kept.

## When to keep that
- **Formal or written style**, verbs such as **announce, state, declare, confirm, maintain, assert, reveal, point out, concede, stress, claim, indicate**: > The minister **announced that** the budget would be revised.
- **A word comes between the verb and the clause**: > She said **quietly that** she would not sign. > He told me **yesterday that** the deal had collapsed.
- **Several clauses in a row** — repeating that helps the listener: > She said **that** she was exhausted **and that** she wanted to go home.
- **The clause begins with an adverbial or a parenthesis**: > He said **that**, in his opinion, the plan would fail.
- **A that-clause as the subject**: *That she had lied surprised nobody.* (formal; more usual: *It surprised nobody that she had lied.*).

## What changes in the clause
When we report in a different time or place, pronouns and time/place words change.

| Direct speech | Reported speech |
|---|---|
| now, today | then, at that time; that day |
| yesterday | the day before, the previous day |
| tomorrow | the next day, the following day |
| last week / ago | the week before / before, earlier |
| this, these, here | that, those, there |

> "I'll see you **tomorrow**," Tom said. → Tom said he would see me **the next day**.
If we report on the same day and in the same place, we can keep the original words: *She said she'd come **tomorrow**.*

## Verbs with that-clauses: is a person needed?
- **tell, remind, assure, convince, warn, inform** always take a person: *He assured **us** that it was safe.*
- **say, explain, mention, announce, suggest, point out** use **to** before the person: *She explained **to us** that the system was down.* ~~She explained us that...~~

## That after nouns and adjectives
After nouns such as **news, claim, rumour, evidence, proof, belief, hope, fact, idea, suspicion**, that is required: > We were shocked by the **news that** the factory would close. > There is no **evidence that** he lied. > The **fact that** she lied hurt him.
After adjectives (**afraid, sure, certain, aware, glad, sorry, surprised**) and in **It's a pity / a shame / strange that...**, that can be dropped in speech.

## Common mistakes
- ~~She said me that she was tired.~~ → She **told me** that... / She **said** that...
- ~~He told that he was ill.~~ → He **told us** that he was ill.
- ~~He said that "I am tired".~~ → He said that **he was** tired.
- ~~She explained me that...~~ → She explained **to me** that...
structure:
## Схема
> reporting verb + (**that**) + subject + verb
> tell / remind / assure + **person** + (that) + clause
> say / explain / announce + (**to** + person) + (that) + clause

## Когда that нужен
| Ситуация | Пример |
|---|---|
| after noun | the **news that** she had resigned |
| after adverb / adverbial | said **quietly that** · told me **yesterday that** |
| second clause | ... and **that** she wanted to go |
| subject clause | **That** he lied surprised nobody. |
| formal verb | The minister **announced that**... |

## Указатели времени и места
| Прямая речь | Косвенная речь |
|---|---|
| now | then / at that time |
| today | that day |
| yesterday | the day before |
| tomorrow | the next / following day |
| last year / two years ago | the year before / two years before |
| here | there |
| this | that |

exercises.title: Время и место в косвенной речи
exercises.instruction: Вставьте слово(а), которое нужно в косвенной речи (рассказ ведётся через несколько дней и в другом месте).

items.text: 'I'll see you tomorrow,' said Tom. → Tom said he would see me {{the next day|the following day|the day after}}.
'We moved here last year,' she said. → She said they had moved there {{the year before|the previous year}}.
'I'm busy now,' he said. → He said he was busy {{then|at that time|at the time}}.
'I bought this laptop two weeks ago,' said Ann. → Ann said she had bought {{that|the}} laptop two weeks {{before|earlier}}.
'I'll leave tonight,' he said. → He said he would leave {{that night|that evening}}.
'My boss was here yesterday,' said Eva. → Eva said her boss had been there {{the day before|the previous day}}.
'I've been here since Monday,' he said. → He said he {{had been}} there since Monday.

exercises.title: Где нужен that
exercises.instruction: Вставьте **that** там, где его нельзя опускать или он делает фразу яснее.

items.text: She said quietly {{that}} she would not sign.
He told me yesterday {{that}} the deal had collapsed.
We were shocked by the news {{that}} the factory would close.
There is no evidence {{that}} the drug causes harm.
He said he was ill and {{that}} he needed a rest.
The fact {{that}} she lied hurt him deeply.
{{That}} the project was late surprised nobody.

items.q: (Said on Monday, reported a week later.) 'I'll call you tomorrow,' she said. → She said she would call me ___.
items.why: Сообщаем через неделю: **tomorrow** → **the next day**. (Если бы сообщали уже во вторник, сказали бы *today*.)

items.q: (Reported a week later.) 'We're leaving now,' they said. → They said they were leaving ___.
(Reported from another city.) 'I like this place,' she said. → She said she liked ___ place.
(Reported later.) 'I saw him last week,' said Mia. → Mia said she'd seen him ___.
He told ___ that the flight was cancelled.
The news ___ she had resigned surprised everyone.
___ the experiment failed was no surprise.
'I'm tired,' he told me. → He told me ___ tired.
items.why: **that he was** — придаточное с прямым порядком слов.

items.why: **that** стоит сразу после глагола, перед вводным оборотом.

items.q: 'I am tired,' she said. Which is correct?
options: She said that she was tired.
She said that she is tired yesterday.

items.q: In which sentence can 'that' NOT be omitted?
options: The rumour ___ he resigned is false.

items.q: He said that he was exhausted and ___ he needed a holiday.
